headline: COL @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is COL 3.86 at PIT 5.07, with a projected total of 8.93. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward COL: COL moved -0.16 runs while PIT moved -0.37, changing the projected margin by +0.21 runs. The projected total fell -0.53, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +10.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Paul Skenes has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Konnor Griffin, Oneil Cruz, TJ Rumfield, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Billy Cook because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
